products.name: Monitaur
products.note: Model monitoring with built-in governance; unified monitoring + governance platform

profile_text.body:
Monitaur is an AI governance software company that describes itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of your AI." Its platform is aimed at enterprises, with a particular focus on regulated industries such as insurance and financial services, where it targets use cases including underwriting, claims, and risk model management. The company positions its offering as a way to unify policies, validate models at scale, monitor performance continuously, and demonstrate fairness and regulatory alignment to both internal teams and external auditors.

The core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform combining model monitoring with built-in governance controls. The site describes capabilities covering policy development, model validation, third-party AI risk management, and support for agentic AI systems. Monitaur references case studies involving a leading insurance provider, an enterprise insurer managing third-party AI projects, and a Fortune 200 financial services or insurance company, though none are identified by name. The company also notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance as a Visionary.

The held facts confirm Monitaur maintains an active profile on theworldofai.org with the platform listed under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
